Create transparent PNG sprite sheet EXACTLY four columns by two rows, eight equal square cells. Read guide left-right top row then bottom row. Maroon far limbs include shield arm. Shield rigid same height/width across ALL frames, hammer rigid same handle and head sizes.

Frame1 near leg forward landing, far heel folded back; frame2 near knee compresses under weight; frame3 near leg pushes backward, far knee comes forward; frame4 short flight with near leg behind, far leg reaching forward; frame5 far leg forward landing and near heel folded back; frame6 far knee compresses; frame7 far leg pushes backward and near knee comes forward; frame8 short flight with far leg back and near leg forward. Hammer arm has small controlled opposite swing, shield stable. Cape follows with delayed small wave, not a huge flapping flag. Coarse angular gothic pixel-art illustration exactly matching image1: thick coal outlines, bone beige, dusty mauve armor shadows, burgundy cloth, flat distinct shade blocks. No blur/glow/gradients/new details. 10% transparent margins around each figure. All ground-contact poses same baseline, airborne poses feet slightly above that baseline. Keep broad short proportions matching reference, NOT the thin knight.
